name: dl_text_patch
description: PER-IFC DISPLAY-LIST PATCHING FOR TEXT CONTENT CHANGES (USER mandate 2026-08-17). Editing a text node's content re-shapes and relayouts its IFC - that work is REAL and layout_passes counts it - but the display-list build must be the PATCH: unchanged nodes splice their item runs from the previous DL, only the reflowed IFC (and size-changed nodes) re-emit, and the damage is the touched strip, not the frame. The gate: a STRUCTURE-PRESERVED reconcile (zero fresh nodes, zero drops, no CSS dirt). The NC inside this scenario: a CSS-dirty pass (set_node_css_override changing width) must NOT splice - restyled items changed paint without reflowing, so the same marker must read false (full emission).
